question: Monolithic pillars of sandstone during Ashoka’s reign, were crowned with animal figures like _________ elephant and lion along with inscriptions of Buddhist concepts.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bull**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The monolithic sandstone pillars of Ashoka's reign were crowned with animal figure bulls.**
 
• Bulls
 
• The** bull on the pillar represents the zodiac sign of Taurus**, the month in which Buddha was born. 
 
• The pillars also have inscriptions of Buddhist concepts and commemorate events in the life of the Buddha.&n
